name: Scoreboard
blurb: Every one of your ten starters added up — highest team score of the week
symbol: a crown over three ascending scoreboard bars

name: Crash and Burn
blurb: Your team score this week minus last week — the biggest fall
symbol: a sharply descending arrow striking a cracked football, with angular flame shapes

name: Not Dead Yet
blurb: Your team score this week minus last week — the biggest climb
symbol: a football with rising phoenix wings and an upward heartbeat chevron

name: Unlucky Schedule
blurb: Of the six teams that lost their matchup, the one that scored most
symbol: a broken horseshoe framing an upright football, small lightning slash

name: Photo Finish
blurb: The matchup decided by the smallest margin — both teams split it
symbol: A bold front-facing sports photo camera with a large circular shutter lens, the shutter blades surrounding a small American football. A short straight black-and-ivory checkered finish stripe runs across the bottom of the camera, and one small angular flash spark sits above its top right. Clear camera silhouette with chunky angular shoulders and an oversized lens. Emphasize the instant captured at the finish: camera plus football plus finish stripe, all one compact icon. No racing chevrons, no arrows, no flying ribbon. Keep the number of shapes restrained.

name: Run Forrest Run
blurb: Rushing yards added up across all ten starters, quarterback scrambles included
symbol: a single football cleat with broad sweeping speed wings

name: Run Forrest Run · Shrimp variant
blurb: Rushing yards added up across all ten starters, quarterback scrambles included
symbol: A curled shrimp wrapped around an American football, inspired by the movie reference.

name: Unsung Hero
blurb: The single highest scoring player you left on your bench
symbol: a heroic five-point star rising above a simple sideline bench

name: Bombs Away: WR Edition
blurb: Longest single catch by one starting wide receiver — receivers only, not backs or tight ends
symbol: two receiver gloves reaching up to catch a comet-shaped American football

name: Big Leg
blurb: Longest single field goal made by your starting kicker
symbol: a kicking cleat launching a football through tall goalposts on a single rising arc

name: Turnover Machine
blurb: Interceptions plus fumble recoveries by your starting defense — ties go to the higher scoring defense
symbol: two chunky mechanical curved arrows circling an American football like a precision machine

name: Sack Attack
blurb: Sacks by your starting defense
symbol: a heavy clenched armored fist crushing a quarterback helmet, stylized and non-graphic

name: Stickies
blurb: Catches added up across all ten starters
symbol: one open receiver glove with an American football firmly attached at its center

name: 6 God(s)
blurb: Rushing and receiving touchdowns added up across all ten starters — passing touchdowns do not count
symbol: one large embossed numeral 6 crowned with a floating halo and two compact laurel branches; the 6 is the only permitted numeral

name: Bombs Away: QB Edition
blurb: Longest single completion by one starting quarterback, measured to where the play ended
symbol: an American football launching from a quarterback throwing hand with a long sharply rising trail

name: Put The Team On My Back (Greg Jennings)
blurb: One starter’s points as a share of their whole team’s score
symbol: Atlas kneeling on one knee, supporting an enormous American football across his shoulders and raised hands in place of the globe.

name: Running From The Cops Speed
blurb: Longest single carry by one starting running back — backs only
symbol: a forward-leaning football cleat breaking through a speedometer arc with three fast motion streaks

name: Now Watch This Drive
blurb: The longest touchdown drive your starting quarterback marched — measured from where his offense first got the ball
symbol: A simplified but recognizable portrait silhouette of George W. Bush, the former US president, hitting a golf driver, referencing his famous 'Now watch this drive' golf clip. Three-quarter full body pose at the finish of the swing, feet planted, torso turning, both arms holding a long golf driver high over his shoulder. His recognizable short side-parted gray hair, prominent ears, long nose and angular face in a few bold flat shapes; no hat. White short-sleeve polo shirt and dark straight golf trousers, restrained pink accent panels. A tiny white golf ball and two short pink motion arcs indicate the drive. One person, one golf club, no other figures. Flat vector-like pictogram rather than photo or detailed caricature. No written words or political logos.

name: Air Raid
blurb: Receiving yards added up across all ten starters
symbol: three descending American footballs with diagonal sweeping contrails

name: Gunslinger
blurb: Passing yards added up across all ten starters — normally just your quarterback
symbol: an American football flying out of a stylized throwing hand inside a precise target ring

name: Yards From Scrimmage
blurb: Rushing plus receiving yards added up across all ten starters
symbol: two bold routes merging around a central American football into one powerful forward arrow over field yard lines

name: Bell Cow
blurb: Most carries by one starting running back — backs only
symbol: a powerful bull-head silhouette with a small heavy cowbell below its chin

name: Longest Touchdown
blurb: Longest single touchdown scored by one of your starters, measured by who carried it in — a run or a catch. Throwing it does not count, so a touchdown pass goes to the receiver who caught it and never to the quarterback, though a quarterback who runs one in wins it like anyone else
symbol: a winged American football streaking over receding yard lines into two end zone pylons

name: Highest-Scoring Starter
blurb: Fantasy points of your single best starter
symbol: a large radiant five-point superstar with an American football inset and a small victory crown

name: Leg Day
blurb: Every field goal your kicker made, distances added together
symbol: a powerful cleat below three successive ascending kicking arcs ending between goalposts

name: Defense Wins Championships
blurb: Touchdowns scored by your starting defense
symbol: a championship trophy with an armored football helmet as its cup and compact laurels

name: Bend Don’t Break
blurb: Points your starting defense gave up — fewest wins
symbol: a thick flexible steel defensive wall bending under an incoming arrow but remaining intact

name: YAC Attack
blurb: Yards gained after the catch, all ten starters
symbol: an American football held in a gloved hand bursting through a broken circular tackle ring

name: Explosive Plays
blurb: Plays that gained 40 yards or more, all ten starters
symbol: an American football at the center of a bold angular starburst explosion

name: First Blood
blurb: How many of your starters scored the opening touchdown of their own game
symbol: a sharp spearhead arrow piercing a small end-zone flag with a single dramatic lightning burst; sports symbolism, no gore

name: Yards Per Touch
blurb: Your starting backs’ yards divided by their touches — needs 10 carries
symbol: an American football inside a speed gauge with its needle reaching the highest point
